summary: Two single-value sliders, Volume and Brightness, each with a live readout.
use: Adjusting a continuous setting such as volume or brightness.
spec: Volume: `<Slider bind:value={volume} min={0} max={100} />` with initial `$state(60)`
Brightness: `<Slider bind:value={brightness} min={0} max={100} />` with initial `$state(40)`
